observation: urgency_service_hold_throughput ends at 97,877 bit/slot, Jain 0.3248, zero starvation, P99 46 and max wait 48; it weakly improves every KPI versus equal-third except max wait, which is unchanged.
mechanism_hypothesis: Throughput 0.25 preserves useful transmissions; urgency combines deficit and waiting information, while Jain and Service at 0.20 remain sufficient to shape rotation and coverage.
counter_evidence: Equal-quarter urgency and group Throughput+Service both reach safe checkpoints and later collapse; therefore the result is weight-geometry and trajectory dependent, not a monotonic urgency effect.
scope: One seed (1701), static heterogeneous CQI, full-buffer, deterministic final validation.
thesis_wording: Trong cấu hình hiện tại, urgency_service tại T/J/S/U = 0,25/0,20/0,20/0,35 là ứng viên cân bằng tốt nhất: nó cải thiện Jain và P99 mà không đánh đổi goodput hoặc starvation so với mốc T–J–S bằng nhau. Kết luận này cần xác nhận đa seed.

observation: deficit_service is stable in 4/8 regimes, including all three pair-hold geometries; group T+S achieves Jain 0.2921, P99 43 and max wait 44 with zero starvation.
mechanism_hypothesis: Per-UE throughput deficit supplies targeted credit after two baseline anchors create successful service and enough coverage; unlike a global service score, it identifies which UE is under-served.
counter_evidence: X-heavy and single-hold Throughput/Service fully collapse; equal-quarter degrades after a safe checkpoint.
scope: Structural substitution evidence only; not statistical proof that deficit_service replaces a baseline reward generally.
thesis_wording: Throughput-deficit service có giá trị như một shaping objective có credit theo UE và có thể thay một phần từng reward nền khi hai anchor còn lại đủ mạnh, nhưng không hoạt động ổn định như objective chi phối.

observation: Low-throughput raw score is exactly 0 at the final checkpoint in five collapse regimes and only becomes nonzero in hold-T, T+J and J+S geometries.
mechanism_hypothesis: When at least 10% of UEs have zero throughput, P10 is zero and the percentile score supplies no marginal learning signal to distinguish actions.
counter_evidence: T+J is stable with raw score 0.0736, showing the component can shape a policy after other rewards move the lower tail away from zero.
scope: Evidence applies to the current P10 score definition and traffic model.
thesis_wording: Low-throughput percentile hiện có dead-zone: nó không thể tự kéo chính sách ra khỏi trạng thái nhiều UE có throughput bằng 0, mà chỉ hoạt động sau khi Throughput–Jain đã tạo một đáy phân phối dương.

observation: PF utility is stable in only hold-Jain; final Jain is 0.1305 despite zero starvation, and two regimes late-collapse after an intermediate safe checkpoint.
mechanism_hypothesis: The normalized PF score is small and does not provide sufficiently targeted rotation/coverage credit; stochastic rollouts continue to show high Jain while deterministic mean policy remains concentrated.
counter_evidence: Hold-Jain raises goodput to 106,570 and avoids starvation, so PF utility can be useful as a throughput-leaning modifier under a Jain anchor.
scope: Does not prove PF scheduling is ineffective; only this reward normalization and PPO setup are tested.
thesis_wording: PF utility ở công thức hiện tại không thay thế Jain fairness và không tạo anchor coverage độc lập; nó chỉ ổn định khi Jain được giữ lại, với đánh đổi fairness deterministic đáng kể.

observation: Across all cases, last-32-update stochastic training Jain is roughly 0.57–0.66 while deterministic final Jain ranges from about 0.04 to 0.32; failed policies can therefore look fair during sampled training.
mechanism_hypothesis: Beta action noise produces cross-slot UE rotation that the deterministic mean priorities do not encode.
counter_evidence: Stable cases also retain a gap, so the gap alone does not imply collapse; it is a diagnostic warning, not a sufficient failure criterion.
scope: Uses rollout Jain and deterministic validation Jain, which are related but not identical measurement contexts.
thesis_wording: Round 07 tiếp tục xác nhận rằng fairness trên stochastic training trajectory không đủ để chứng minh mean policy triển khai đã học được rotation công bằng.
